author: Afloat16

coverage.scope: All currently available open, closed and merged PR title/body and latest changed-file index, plus actual relevant production diffs (including pre-refactor monolithic manifolds.py and ProductSpace_TODO.py), and the relevant source implementation at all 33 original fork branch heads. The index is not a claim to have read every unrelated changed-file body or historical overwritten PR revision.

duplicate.title: Fix Euclidean cdist gradients at zero distance

duplicate_incident.exact_production_overlap: Both change Euclidean.cdist to mask zero squared distances before sqrt and restore exact zero afterwards. Upstream #288 also adds tests/test_euclidean_cdist_gradients.py.
miss_mechanism: The upstream PR existed before this work and was included in the fetched all-state metadata.
The earlier ProductManifold handoff already explicitly listed #288 as related prior work; the conflict was therefore already known in this campaign.
When later choosing the Euclidean.cdist candidate, this known conflict record was not carried into the candidate's exclusion check.
A title-display filter that did not include cdist and a later issues-only search failed to surface it again; reviewing only #238 and #278 was insufficient.
The previous claim of new, fully deduplicated Euclidean.cdist work was incorrect.
duplicate_incident.action: Disqualify completely. Do not create a PR or count it as an eligible improvement. Clear prefilled URL; retain the fork source only as an audit record.

prs.title: Preserve SPD distance gradients at repeated eigenvalues

related_prior_work.distinction: This is close numerical prior art: SPD AIM distance already replaced eigendecomposition whitening with Cholesky. It changes only symmetric_positive_definite.py and computes generalized eigenvalues. The new independently failing Siegel path operates on complex matrices followed by Cayley/Takagi values (including Finsler metrics); its orthogonal-congruence invariance and complex dtype handling are separately established and tested. This is a new unaddressed distance path, not a claim that Cholesky whitening is a new idea.

combined_validation.note: Test facts are preserved for the exact six integrated source branches, but cdist is not a new contribution. Birkhoff adds the sixth eligible improvement and was validated separately.

process_changes: Use an explicit candidate exclusion ledger containing known all-state PRs and old fork implementations; consult it before implementing.
Fetch the complete PR changed-file index, not only keyword-matched titles; inspect all changes touching candidate methods and historical aliases.
Never treat an issues-only search as a PR search.
Record similar techniques in other methods and explain the independently failing path; do not claim an existing mathematical technique is original.
Refresh PR heads before final handoff and mark duplicate discoveries immediately.
